title.context: This title appears at the top of the units management page where instructors can view, create, and organize their learning units. It serves as the main heading for the section that displays all available units in a course or curriculum.

component.description: The units page component displays a comprehensive view of all learning units within a course. It allows instructors to manage their curriculum structure and provides students with access to their assigned learning materials.

title.usage: Page title heading displayed at the top of the units management interface
title.impact: High - This is a primary navigation element that helps users understand they are in the units section of the platform

create_unit.context: This text appears as a button or action item in the instructor's unit management interface, allowing them to initiate the creation of a new learning unit. Users see this when they are in the units overview or dashboard section and want to add new content to their course.

component.description: The units management component provides instructors with tools to create, organize, and manage learning units within their courses. This interface displays existing units and provides creation actions for new content modules.

create_unit.usage: Primary action button that triggers the unit creation workflow when clicked
create_unit.impact: Critical - this is the primary entry point for instructors to create educational content on the platform

edit_unit.context: This text appears as a button or menu option in the instructor interface when viewing a learning unit. Instructors see this action to modify existing unit content, structure, or settings within their course materials.

component.description: This component provides action buttons for unit management including editing, duplicating, and deleting units. It appears in the instructor dashboard when managing course content and learning materials.

edit_unit.usage: Button or menu item text that instructors click to enter edit mode for a learning unit
edit_unit.impact: High - This is essential for instructors to maintain and update their course content effectively

delete_unit.context: This text appears as a destructive action option in the unit management interface when instructors are viewing or editing a learning unit. It is typically displayed as a button or menu item that allows instructors to permanently remove an entire unit and all its associated content from their course.

component.description: This component renders action buttons and menu options for unit management operations. It provides instructors with various administrative actions they can perform on learning units, including editing, duplicating, and deletion functionality.

delete_unit.usage: Button or menu item that triggers unit deletion when clicked by an instructor.
delete_unit.impact: Critical because this is a destructive action that permanently removes educational content and must be clearly understood to prevent accidental data loss.

unit_name.context: This text appears as a label or heading in the units management interface where instructors create and organize learning units. Users see this when setting up new units or viewing existing unit details in the course structure.

component.description: Component that handles the creation and editing of learning units, allowing instructors to define unit properties including the unit name. This interface is accessed when instructors are building course content and organizing lessons into structured units.

unit_name.usage: Form field label or section heading displayed when creating or editing a learning unit.
unit_name.impact: Important - This label is essential for content organization and helps instructors clearly identify and structure their course materials.

unit_description.context: This text appears as a label or heading in unit management interfaces where instructors can view or edit descriptive information about a learning unit. Students may also see this when viewing unit details or in unit overview sections that explain what the unit covers.

component.description: A form component that allows instructors to create or edit unit information including title, description, and other metadata. This component is used in unit creation workflows and unit editing interfaces.

unit_description.usage: Form field label or section heading that identifies the description input area for a learning unit.
unit_description.impact: Important - helps instructors understand where to input unit descriptions and helps students identify descriptive content about units they're studying.

published.context: This status indicator appears in the units management interface to show that a learning unit has been made available to students. Instructors see this label next to units that are currently live and accessible for student enrollment and completion.

component.description: A status badge component that displays the current publication state of learning units in lists and detail views. It helps instructors quickly identify which units are live versus draft or unpublished states.

published.usage: Status badge or label displayed in unit listing tables and unit detail headers.
published.impact: High - Critical for instructors to understand which content is visible to students and affects course delivery.

draft.context: This text appears as a status indicator for learning units that instructors have created but not yet published. Users see this label in unit lists, dashboards, or content management areas to distinguish between unpublished and live content.

component.description: A status badge component that displays the current publication state of learning units. It helps instructors track which units are ready for students and which still need work before publishing.

draft.usage: Status badge or label that appears next to unit titles in content management interfaces.
draft.impact: Important - This helps instructors organize their workflow and prevents accidental publication of incomplete content.

assign_to_section.context: This text appears in the units management interface where instructors organize learning content into sections. It is displayed as an action option when instructors are creating or editing units and need to categorize them into specific course sections or chapters.

component.description: Component that handles the organization and categorization of learning units within course sections. It provides instructors with tools to assign newly created or existing units to appropriate course sections or chapters.

assign_to_section.usage: Button or dropdown action that allows instructors to assign a unit to a specific course section
assign_to_section.impact: Important - Essential for course organization and ensuring students can find units in the correct sections

no_units.context: This message appears in the units management interface when an instructor or student navigates to a course or section that contains no learning units. Users see this empty state message in place of the typical units list, indicating they need to create content or that no units have been assigned to them yet.

component.description: This component renders the list of learning units for a course or assignment section. It displays unit cards with progress indicators for students or management options for instructors, showing this empty state when no units exist.

no_units.usage: Empty state message displayed in the main content area when no units are found
no_units.impact: Medium - helps users understand why no content is visible and may prompt instructors to create units or students to check with their instructor
